description: A white AirPods charging case sits on the yellow tabletop in front of you, with a red cloth backdrop behind it. The left hand steadies and opens the AirPods case (left-hand object) while the right hand reaches in, pinches and removes one earbud (right-hand object) to the right, then lifts the other earbud out and places both earbuds down on the table as the left hand keeps the case nearby.
